response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's mandatory requirements. C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. There is no Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a fintech but the work was Node/TypeScript), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth. Recent work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, making this a poor fit despite solid engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Deep systems/performance experience (low-latency DLang services handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development
Broad polyglot background with SQL, Java, and scripting exposure covering several 'desirable' skills
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and none recent or Windows-platform focused
No Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain knowledge
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; database work is mostly MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain expertise
Strong general engineering and performance background
